signals.content: We are asking the DoW to offer these same terms to all AI companies, which in our opinion we think everyone should be willing to accept. We have expressed our strong desire to see things de-escalate away from legal and governmental actions and towards reasonable agreements.
signals.score_reason: Twitter/X discussion signal. Final score: 50. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en: We urge the DoW to extend these terms to all AI companies, which we believe should be acceptable to all. We express our strong desire for de-escalation from legal and governmental actions towards reasonable agreements.
signals.brief_ar: نحن نحث وزارة الدفاع على تقديم هذه الشروط لجميع شركات الذكاء الاصطناعي، التي نعتقد أنها يجب أن تكون مقبولة للجميع. نعرب عن رغبتنا القوية في التهدئة بعيداً عن الإجراءات القانونية والحكومية ونحو اتفاقات معقولة.

signals.title: @sama: More importantly, we believe everyone deserves to use AI and are committed to free access,
signals.content: More importantly, we believe everyone deserves to use AI and are committed to free access, because we believe access creates agency. More Texans use ChatGPT for free than total people use Claude in the US, so we have a differently-shaped problem than they do. (If you want to pay for ChatGPT Plus or Pro, we don''t show you ads.)

signals.brief_en: We believe everyone deserves to use AI and are committed to free access, as it creates agency. Our user base for free ChatGPT surpasses Claude's total US users.
signals.brief_ar: نعتقد أن الجميع يستحقون استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي ونلتزم بالوصول المجاني، لأنه يخلق قوة وفاعلية. عدد مستخدمي تشات جي بي تي المجاني أكبر من عدد مستخدمي كلود في الولايات المتحدة

signals.content: Anthropic serves an expensive product to rich people. We are glad they do that and we are doing that too, but we also feel strongly that we need to bring AI to billions of people who can’t pay for subscriptions.
signals.score_reason: Twitter/X discussion signal. Final score: 50. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en: Anthropic offers high-end AI products to affluent clients. We acknowledge their efforts and are working towards similar goals, while also striving to make AI accessible to billions who cannot afford subscription-based services.
signals.brief_ar: تُقدم Anthropic منتجات ذكاء اصطناعي فاخرة للعملاء الأغنياء. نحن نقر بالجهد المبذول ونتطلع إلى تحقيق أهداف مماثلة، مع التركيز على جعل الذكاء الاصطناعي متاحًا لمليارات الأشخاص الذين لا يستطيعون دفع اشتراكات الخدمات.

signals.content: Maybe even more importantly: Anthropic wants to control what people do with AI—they block companies they don''t like from using their coding product (including us), they want to write the rules themselves for what people can and can''t use AI for, and now they also want to tell other companies what their business models can be.

signals.brief_en: Anthropic aims to control AI usage, blocking unwanted companies, including us, from using their product and seeking to set rules for AI applications and business models.
